changes.title: Version 3.0.1
changes.summary: Maryland moved to the group that files only targeted solicitations: a mailed, recorded or online solicitation about an injury, accident, disaster or a criminal or jailable traffic case goes to Bar Counsel within 3 days after it is sent. Ordinary ads are still not filed.

changes.title: Version 3.0.0
changes.summary: Record-specific columns moved from filing.csv to filing-values.csv, one row per id, column and value; every figure is unchanged.

changes.title: Version 2.0.0
changes.summary: The field notes is now detail, and each source gives its label, link, exact quote and the date it was read.

changes.title: Ad review volumes added
changes.summary: New fields give how many lawyer ads a bar reviewed in a year, as the bar itself states it: Florida, Texas and Kentucky, plus Nevada. Each count carries its source and quote, and whether it is exact, approximate or a floor. Counts are not comparable across states.

changes.title: Days from filing to first use added
changes.summary: Five new fields state, where the bar or court's own rule says so, how many days before or after first use a filing is due, how many days the bar takes to respond, and how far ahead an optional advisory opinion is requested. Each stated number cites the rule or bar page.
